lit: Enter a village, follow its customs.
en: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.

lit: Familiarity breeds skill.
en: Practice makes perfect.

say: qiān lǐ zhī xíng, shǐ yú zú xià
lit: A journey of a thousand li begins beneath your feet.
en: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

lit: One stone, two birds.
en: Kill two birds with one stone.

lit: Wanting speed, you won't arrive.
en: Haste makes waste.

say: sài wēng shī mǎ, yān zhī fēi fú
lit: The old man lost his horse — who knows it isn't luck?
en: A blessing in disguise.

say: bǎi wén bù rú yí jiàn
lit: Hearing a hundred times isn't as good as seeing once.
en: Seeing is believing.

say: huó dào lǎo, xué dào lǎo
lit: Live till old, learn till old.
en: You're never too old to learn.

lit: Failure is the mother of success.
en: Failure is the mother of success.

say: sān rén xíng, bì yǒu wǒ shī
lit: Among three people walking, one can be my teacher. (Confucius)
en: You can learn from anyone.

lit: Drawing a snake and adding feet.
en: Overdoing it / gilding the lily.

lit: Playing the lute to a cow.
en: Talking to a wall / casting pearls before swine.

lit: One look, feelings fixed.
en: Love at first sight.

lit: Horse horse, tiger tiger.
en: So-so, careless.

say: yǒu zhì zhě shì jìng chéng
lit: Whoever has the will, the deed gets done.
en: Where there's a will, there's a way.

say: bú rù hǔ xué, yān dé hǔ zǐ
lit: If you don't enter the tiger's den, how will you get its cub?
en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.

lit: Give up halfway down the road.
en: To quit halfway.

lit: Good things go through much grinding.
en: Good things take time / don't come easy.

say: chē dào shān qián bì yǒu lù
lit: When the cart reaches the mountain, there's always a road.
en: Things will work out.

lit: Hard times reveal true feelings.
en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

lit: Guarding a tree stump, waiting for a rabbit.
en: Waiting for luck instead of working for it.

say: tiānxià méiyǒu bú sàn de yánxí
lit: There's no banquet in the world that never ends.
en: All good things must come to an end.
